title: 1.X4.7
description: Changes almost all 1.4.7 textures to latest ones
body:
Changes all 1.4.7 textures to latest ones (except panorama).

Originally created to develop lore of one OC of mine, but in the end it was more efficient to make a whole separate .jar version, since texture packs can't change lang and sounds.

To install, you must place it into the "texturepacks" folder. Create it if it doesn't exist yet.

Should be compatible with OptiFine.
